# MUI X Documentation

This documentation covers all MUI X packages including Data Grid, Date Pickers, Charts, Tree View, and other components.

---

## Date and Time Pickers

This is the documentation for the Date and Time Pickers package.
It contains comprehensive guides, components, and utilities for building user interfaces.

- [Quickstart](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/quickstart.md): Install the MUI X Date and Time Pickers package and set up your date library to start building.
- [Base concepts](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/base-concepts.md): The Date and Time Pickers expose a lot of components to fit your every need.

### Components

#### Date components

- [Date Picker](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/date-picker.md): The Date Picker component lets users select a date.
- [Date Field](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/date-field.md): The Date Field component lets users select a date with the keyboard.
- [Date Calendar](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/date-calendar.md): The Date Calendar component lets users select a date without any input or popper / modal.

#### Time components

- [Time Picker](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/time-picker.md): The Time Picker component lets the user select a time.
- [Time Field](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/time-field.md): The Time Field component lets the user select a time with the keyboard.
- [Time Clock](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/time-clock.md): The Time Clock component lets the user select a time without any input or popper / modal.
- [Digital Clock](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/digital-clock.md): The Digital Clock lets the user select a time without any input or popper / modal.

#### Date Time components

- [Date Time Picker](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/date-time-picker.md): The Date Time Picker component lets users select a date and time.
- [Date Time Field](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/date-time-field.md): The Date Time Field component lets users select a date and a time with the keyboard.

#### Date Range components

- [Date Range Picker](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/date-range-picker.md): The Date Range Picker lets the user select a range of dates.
- [Date Range Field](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/date-range-field.md): The Date Range Field lets the user select a date range with the keyboard.
- [Date Range Calendar](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/date-range-calendar.md): The Date Range Calendar lets the user select a range of dates without any input or popper / modal.

#### Time Range components

- [Time Range Picker](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/time-range-picker.md): The Time Range Picker lets users select a range of time values.
- [Time Range Field](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/time-range-field.md): The Time Range Field lets the user select a range of time with the keyboard.

#### Date Time Range components

- [Date Time Range Picker](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/date-time-range-picker.md): The Date Time Range Picker lets the user select a range of dates with an explicit starting and ending time.
- [Date Time Range Field](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/date-time-range-field.md): The Date Time Range Field lets the user select a range of dates with an explicit starting and ending time with the keyboard.

- [Field components](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/fields.md): The field components let the user input date and time values with a keyboard and refined keyboard navigation.

### Main features

- [Validation](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/validation.md): Add custom validation to user inputs.
- [Components lifecycle](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/lifecycle.md): This page explains when the onChange, onAccept, and onClose callbacks are called.
- [Shortcuts](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/shortcuts.md): The date picker lets you add custom shortcuts.
- [Accessibility](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/accessibility.md): Learn how the Date and Time Pickers implement accessibility features and guidelines, including keyboard navigation that follows international standards.

### Localization

- [Translated components](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/localization.md): Date and Time Pickers support translations between languages.
- [Date format and localization](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/adapters-locale.md): Date and Time Pickers support formats from different locales.
- [UTC and timezones](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/timezone.md): Date and Time Pickers support UTC and timezones.
- [Calendar systems](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/calendar-systems.md): Use the Date and Time Pickers with non-Gregorian calendars.

### Customization

- [Custom subcomponents](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/custom-components.md): Learn how to override parts of the Date and Time Pickers.
- [Custom layout](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/custom-layout.md): The Date and Time Pickers let you reorganize the layout.
- [Custom field](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/custom-field.md): The Date and Time Pickers let you customize the field by passing props or custom components.
- [Custom opening button](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/custom-opening-button.md): The date picker lets you customize the button to open the views.
- [Customization playground](https://mui.com/x/react-date-pickers/playground.md): Use this playground to experiment with the props that affect the layout of the Date and Time Picker components.

## Charts

This is the documentation for the Charts package.
It contains comprehensive guides, components, and utilities for building user interfaces.

- [Quickstart](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/quickstart.md): Install the MUI X Charts package to start building React data visualization components.
- [Examples](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/examples.md): Browse through our collection of MUI X Chart demos.

### Components

#### Bars

- [Bars overview](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/bars.md): Use bar charts to compare discrete categories and quantities using bar length and a common baseline.
- [Range bar](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/range-bar.md): Use range bar charts to show the span between minimum and maximum values across categories. (premium) 🆕
- [Demos](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/bar-demo.md): Explore bar chart demos and examples.

#### Lines

- [Lines overview](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/lines.md): Use line charts to show trends over time, compare series, and highlight changes in continuous data.
- [Lines demo](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/line-demo.md): Demos that use line charts for basic plots, live data, reference lines, and custom styling.
- [Area demo](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/areas-demo.md): This page groups demos using area charts.

#### Pie

- [Pie overview](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/pie.md): Use pie charts to show parts of a whole as arcs or angles in a circle for quick comparison of proportions.
- [Demo](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/pie-demo.md): Demos that use pie charts for multi-level data, angles, labels, padding, and custom legend or tooltip.

#### Scatter

- [Scatter overview](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/scatter.md): Use scatter charts to plot two variables as points and reveal relationships, correlations, and outliers.
- [Bubble](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/bubble.md): A bubble chart extends scatter by mapping data values to point sizes and colors, revealing a third or fourth dimension in two-dimensional space.
- [Demo](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/scatter-demo.md): Demos that use scatter charts for simple plots, multiple y-axes, and related patterns.

- [Sparkline](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/sparkline.md): Use sparklines to show value trends in a compact chart without axes or coordinates.
- [Gauge](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/gauge.md): Use gauge charts to show a numeric value within a defined range as an arc or meter.
- [Radar](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/radar.md): Use radar charts to compare multiple variables on axes arranged in a circle.
- [Heatmap](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/heatmap.md): Use heatmap charts to show intensity as a grid of colored cells across two dimensions. (pro)

#### Funnel

- [Funnel overview](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/funnel.md): Use funnel charts to show how quantities change through sequential steps, such as conversion or engagement stages.
- [Pyramid demo](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/pyramid.md): The pyramid chart is a variation of the funnel chart.

- [Sankey](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/sankey.md): Use Sankey charts to show how values flow between nodes, with link width proportional to magnitude. (pro)
- [Candlestick](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/candlestick.md): A candlestick chart is used to visualize price movement over time. (premium)
- [Radial Bars](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/radial-bars.md): Use radial bar charts to compare values along periodic categories. (premium)
- [Radial Lines](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/radial-lines.md): Use radial line charts to show trends along periodic values. (premium)
- [Map](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/map.md): Render geographic data. (premium)

#### Main features

- [Accessibility](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/accessibility.md): Learn how the Charts implement accessibility features and guidelines, including keyboard navigation that follows international standards.
- [Animation](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/animation.md): Learn how to customize both CSS and JavaScript-based Chart animations.

#### Axes

- [Overview](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/axis.md): Define, format, and customize Chart axes.
- [Ticks and grid](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/axis-ticks.md): Configure axis ticks and the chart grid.
- [Customization](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/axis-customization.md): Customize how chart axes are rendered and styled.

- [Brush](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/brush.md): Let users select a region on a chart by clicking and dragging.
- [Custom components](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/components.md): Create custom chart components using the provided hooks.
- [Composition](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/composition.md): Learn how to use composition to build advanced custom Charts.
- [Export](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/export.md): Let users export a chart as an image or in PDF format. (pro)
- [Highlighting](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/highlighting.md): Highlight data points and series to provide quick visual feedback.
- [Label](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/label.md): Customize how series and data points are labeled in charts.
- [Legend](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/legend.md): Customize how series and data are identified in chart legends.
- [Localization](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/localization.md): Adapt charts to different languages and locales.
- [Performance](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/performance.md): Learn how to keep charts fast and responsive when rendering large datasets.
- [Stacking](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/stacking.md): Display the decomposition of values by stacking series on top of each other.
- [Styling](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/styling.md): Customize chart appearance, colors, and styling.
- [Radial axes](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/radial-axes.md): Display grid and axes in radial coordinates.
- [References](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/references.md): Add visual markers to add extra context to your charts.
- [Toolbar](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/toolbar.md): Add a toolbar to charts for quick access to common features.
- [Tooltip](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/tooltip.md): Use a tooltip to display additional data when users interact with chart items.
- [Zoom and pan](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/zoom-and-pan.md): Zoom and pan charts or specific axes. (pro)
- [Content Security Policy](https://mui.com/x/react-charts/content-security-policy.md): How to configure a Content Security Policy so MUI X Charts runs correctly and export works when your app restricts script and style sources.

## Tree View

This is the documentation for the Tree View package.
It contains comprehensive guides, components, and utilities for building user interfaces.

- [Quickstart](https://mui.com/x/react-tree-view/quickstart.md): Install the MUI X Tree View package and start building.

- [Expansion](https://mui.com/x/react-tree-view/rich-tree-view/expansion.md): Handle how users can expand and collapse items.

- [Focus](https://mui.com/x/react-tree-view/rich-tree-view/focus.md): Learn how to focus Tree View items.

- [Lazy loading](https://mui.com/x/react-tree-view/rich-tree-view/lazy-loading.md): Lazy load the data from your Tree View. (pro)
- [Ordering](https://mui.com/x/react-tree-view/rich-tree-view/ordering.md): Let users drag and drop items in the Tree View to reorder them. (pro)

### Main features

## Data Grid

This is the documentation for the Data Grid package.
It contains comprehensive guides, components, and utilities for building user interfaces.

- [Quickstart](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/quickstart.md): Install the MUI X Data Grid package and start building your React data table.
- [Features](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/features.md): Explore all of the available features in each of the Data Grid packages.

### Demos

- [time data](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/demos/real-time-data.md): Real-time data updates in the Data Grid, using simulated market data to showcase live changes.
- [Time off calendar](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/demos/time-off-calendar.md): Date range visualization in the Data Grid, using a calendar UI to display and manage time periods.
- [Inventory](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/demos/inventory.md): An inventory dashboard for vendors showcasing product availability.

### Main features

- [Layout](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/layout.md): The Data Grid offers multiple layout modes.

#### Columns

- [Column definition](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/column-definition.md): Define your columns.
- [Column dimensions](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/column-dimensions.md): Customize the dimensions and resizing behavior of your columns.
- [Column visibility](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/column-visibility.md): Define which columns are visible.
- [Custom columns](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/custom-columns.md): Create custom column types.
- [Column header](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/column-header.md): Customize your columns header.
- [Column menu](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/column-menu.md): Customize your columns menu.
- [Column spanning](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/column-spanning.md): Span cells across several columns.
- [Column groups](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/column-groups.md): Group your columns.
- [Column reordering](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/column-ordering.md): The Data Grid Pro lets users drag and drop columns to reorder them. (pro)
- [Column pinning](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/column-pinning.md): Implement pinning to keep columns in the Data Grid visible at all times. (pro)
- [Recipes](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/column-recipes.md): Advanced column customization recipes.

#### Rows

- [Row definition](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/row-definition.md): Define your rows.
- [Row updates](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/row-updates.md): Always keep your rows up to date.
- [Row height](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/row-height.md): Customize the height of your rows.
- [Row spanning](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/row-spanning.md): Span cells across several rows. 🆕
- [detail row panels](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/master-detail.md): Implement master-detail row panels to let users view extended information without leaving the Data Grid. (pro)
- [Row reordering](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/row-ordering.md): The Data Grid Pro lets users drag and drop rows to reorder them. (pro)
- [Row pinning](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/row-pinning.md): Implement pinning to keep rows in the Data Grid visible at all times. (pro)
- [Recipes](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/row-recipes.md): Advanced row customization recipes.

- [Cells](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/cells.md): Learn how to customize the rendered elements and values of a cell.

#### Editing

- [Overview](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/editing.md): The Data Grid has built-in support for cell and row editing.
- [Persistence](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/editing/persistence.md): Persisting edited rows.
- [Custom edit component](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/editing/custom-edit-component.md): Creating custom edit component.
- [Editing events](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/editing/editing-events.md): Using editing events.
- [Recipes editing](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/recipes-editing.md): Advanced grid customization recipes.

- [Sorting](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/sorting.md): Easily sort your rows based on one or several criteria.

#### Filtering

- [Overview](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/filtering.md): Easily filter your rows based on one or several criteria.
- [Customization](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/filtering/customization.md): Ways to customize your filters.
- [Quick filter](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/filtering/quick-filter.md): One filter field to quickly filter grid.
- [side filtering](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/filtering/server-side.md): Filter rows on the server.
- [filters](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/filtering/multi-filters.md): Let end users apply multiple filters to the Data Grid simultaneously. (pro)
- [Header filters](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/filtering/header-filters.md): Give users quick-access column filters in the Data Grid header. (pro)
- [Recipes](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/filtering-recipes.md): Advanced filtering customization recipes.

- [Pagination](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/pagination.md): Easily paginate your rows and only fetch what you need.

#### Selection

- [Row selection](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/row-selection.md): Row selection lets users select and highlight a single row or multiple rows that they can then take action on.
- [Cell selection](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/cell-selection.md): Let users select individual cells or a range of cells. (premium)

- [Virtualization](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/virtualization.md): The grid is high performing thanks to its rows and columns virtualization engine.
- [Accessibility](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/accessibility.md): Learn how the Data Grid implements accessibility features and guidelines, including keyboard navigation that follows international standards.
- [Localization](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/localization.md): The Data Grid's localization features provide the appropriate translations and formatting for users around the world.

### Advanced features

- [Tree data](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/tree-data.md): Use tree data to render rows with parent-child relationships in the Data Grid. (pro)

#### Row grouping

- [Overview](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/row-grouping.md): Group rows together based on column values in the Data Grid.
- [Recipes](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/recipes-row-grouping.md): Advanced grid customization recipes.

- [Aggregation](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/aggregation.md): Add aggregation functions to the Data Grid to let users combine row values. (premium)

#### Pivoting

- [Overview](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/pivoting.md): Rearrange rows and columns to view data from multiple perspectives.

- [Export](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/export.md): Export the rows in CSV or Excel formats, or use the browser's print dialog to print or save as PDF.
- [Copy and paste](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/clipboard.md): Copy and paste data using clipboard.
- [Undo and redo](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/undo-redo.md): Let users undo and reapply changes made to the Data Grid. (premium) 🆕
- [Scrolling](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/scrolling.md): This section presents how to programmatically control the scroll.
- [List view](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/list-view.md): Display data in a single-column list view for a more compact Data Grid on smaller screens and mobile devices. (pro)

#### Server-side data

- [Overview](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/server-side-data.md): Learn how to work with server-side data in the Data Grid using the Data Source layer.
- [Tree data](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/server-side-data/tree-data.md): Implement lazy-loading server-side tree data in the Data Grid using the Data Source layer. (pro)
- [Lazy loading](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/server-side-data/lazy-loading.md): Implement lazy-loading rows with server-side data in the Data Grid using the Data Source layer. (pro)
- [Row grouping](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/server-side-data/row-grouping.md): Implement row grouping with server-side data in the Data Grid using the Data Source layer. (premium)
- [Aggregation](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/server-side-data/aggregation.md): Implement aggregation with server-side data in the Data Grid using the Data Source layer. (premium)
- [Pivoting](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/server-side-data/pivoting.md): Implement pivoting with server-side data in the Data Grid using the Data Source layer. (premium)
- [Recipes](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/server-side-data/recipes.md): Recipes for advanced data source use-cases.

- [Charts integration](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/charts-integration.md): Use the MUI X Charts to visualize data from the Data Grid. (premium) 🆕
- [AI Assistant](https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/ai-assistant.md): Translate natural language into Data Grid views. (premium) 🆕

## Scheduler

This is the documentation for the Scheduler package.
It contains comprehensive guides, components, and utilities for building user interfaces.

- [Quickstart](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/quickstart.md): Install the MUI X Scheduler package and start building your React scheduling components.

### Main features

- [Timezones](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/timezone.md): Display events correctly across different timezones.
- [Recurring events](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/recurring-events.md): Use RRULE strings to create repeating events with daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly patterns. (premium)
- [Accessibility](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/accessibility.md): Learn how the Scheduler implements accessibility features and guidelines, including ARIA semantics, keyboard navigation, and localization of accessible labels.

### Event Calendar

- [Events](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-calendar/events.md): Define events for your Event Calendar.
- [Resources](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-calendar/resources.md): Organize events by assigning them to resources in the Event Calendar.
- [Navigation](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-calendar/navigation.md): Navigate in time to find the events you are looking for.
- [Drag interactions](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-calendar/drag-interactions.md): Re-schedule or resize your events using drag and drop.
- [Editing](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-calendar/editing.md): Configure how events are created and edited.
- [Views](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-calendar/views.md): Choose which views are available in the Event Calendar.
- [Responsiveness 🧪](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-calendar/responsiveness.md): How the Event Calendar adapts its typography to narrow widths.
- [Lazy loading](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-calendar/lazy-loading.md): Fetch events on demand as users navigate dates and views. (premium)
- [Filtering](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-calendar/filtering.md): Search and filter events in the Event Calendar. (premium) (planned)
- [Import and Export](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-calendar/import-export.md): Import and export events from the Event Calendar. (premium) (planned)
- [Preferences](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-calendar/preferences.md): Let your user customize the component to their needs.
- [Localization](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-calendar/localization.md): Translate and localize the Event Calendar for users around the world.

### Event Timeline

- [Events](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-timeline/events.md): Define events for your Event Timeline.
- [Resources](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-timeline/resources.md): Organize events by assigning them to resources in the Event Timeline.
- [Navigation](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-timeline/navigation.md): Navigate in time to find the events you are looking for.
- [Drag interactions](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-timeline/drag-interactions.md): Re-schedule or resize your events using drag and drop.
- [Editing](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-timeline/editing.md): Configure how events are created and edited.
- [Presets](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-timeline/presets.md): The Event Timeline Premium supports several zoom levels to display events at different time scales.
- [Lazy loading](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-timeline/lazy-loading.md): Fetch events on demand as users navigate dates and presets.
- [Virtualization](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-timeline/virtualization.md): Virtualize the Event Timeline for better performance with large datasets.
- [Filtering](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-timeline/filtering.md): Search and filter events in the Event Timeline. (planned)
- [Import and Export](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-timeline/import-export.md): Import and export events from the Event Timeline. (planned)
- [Preferences](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-timeline/preferences.md): Let your user customize the component to their needs.
- [Localization](https://mui.com/x/react-scheduler/event-timeline/localization.md): Translate and localize the Event Timeline for users around the world.

### API reference

## X Chat

This is the documentation for the X Chat package.
It contains comprehensive guides, components, and utilities for building user interfaces.

### Main features

#### Backend Connection

- [Streaming](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/behavior/streaming.md): Stream assistant responses chunk-by-chunk from the adapter into the Chat UI for live, token-by-token updates.

#### Built-in adapters

- [Building an Adapter](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/backend/building-an-adapter.md): <p class="description">Implement a <code>ChatAdapter</code> step by step to connect any backend to the Chat runtime.</p>

- [Error Handling](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/behavior/error-handling.md): Handle errors raised by adapters, streams, and history loading through a unified error model.

### Customization

### Advanced features

#### Building Blocks

- [Messages](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/basics/messages.md): Render conversation history as a virtualized, grouped, auto-scrolling message list.
- [Composer](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/basics/composer.md): Compose and send chat messages with an auto-resizing text area, keyboard shortcuts, and attachment support.
- [Conversation](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/basics/conversation.md): Pair a message list and composer into a single scrollable conversation surface.
- [Layout](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/basics/layout.md): Compose conversation and thread panes in the chat surface, with full control over layout and responsive behavior.

#### Display

#### Message Parts

- [Code Blocks](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/display/message-parts/code-blocks.md): <p class="description">Display code with a language label and copy-to-clipboard button using the <code>ChatCodeBlock</code> component.</p>
- [Sources & Citations](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/display/message-parts/sources-and-citations.md): Display reference links and document excerpts for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications using source parts.

- [Message actions](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/display/message-actions.md): Reveal per-message action buttons on hover or focus for copy, edit, delete, and custom operations.
- [Loading and empty states](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/display/loading-and-empty-states.md): Display loading skeletons while messages load and empty state content when a conversation has no messages.
- [Unread Marker](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/display/unread-marker.md): Highlight messages that arrived while users were away with an inline divider in the chat thread.
- [Date Divider](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/display/date-divider.md): Group messages by day with inline separators inside the chat thread.

#### Behavior

- [Suggestions](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/behavior/suggestions.md): Display prompt suggestions that help users start a conversation or pick their next prompt.
- [Scrolling](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/behavior/scrolling.md): Keep new messages visible with auto-scroll, scroll-to-bottom affordance, and automatic history loading on scroll.
- [Typing indicators](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/behavior/typing-indicators.md): Show users when other participants are composing a message in real time.

#### Multi-conversation

- [Conversation header](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/multi-conversation/conversation-header.md): Display the active conversation's title, subtitle, participants, and action buttons using the themed header components.

#### AI and agents

- [Tool approval](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/ai-and-agents/tool-approval.md): Add human-in-the-loop checkpoints to review and approve or deny agent tool calls before they execute.
- [Reasoning](https://mui.com/x/react-chat/ai-and-agents/reasoning.md): Display chain-of-thought reasoning traces from LLMs alongside streamed chat responses.

### Reference
